title: CommandStatus
description: Status of a command by commandId, asked after a timeout before repeating it with the same commandId (v0.3 §9.2 GET /api/commands/{commandId}; v0.2 D.4; spec §11 rule 7). An unknown commandId is 404 NOT_FOUND (error schema).
$comment: [P] Shape and the state names are a 3D-06 proposal; the sources give only the endpoint.

result.description: The stored result; present when DONE.
